AggregatedComponentEvidence.description:
Per-component aggregated evidence. State is limited to the MVP subset.

``box_area_ratios`` and ``box_centers`` are per-detection spatial
summaries in normalized ROI coordinates; each entry corresponds to one
detection in ``detection_count`` order. They let the rule engine validate
declared spatial constraints without depending on any detector package.
AggregatedComponentEvidence.title: AggregatedComponentEvidence

BoundingBox.description: Pixel-space bounding box with explicit image dimensions.
BoundingBox.title: BoundingBox

BusinessResult.description: External business result. UNCERTAIN always maps to NG.
BusinessResult.title: BusinessResult

FrameQualitySummary.description: Frame quality summary for an inspection.
FrameQualitySummary.title: FrameQualitySummary

InferenceMetadata.description: Typed inference traceability for both detection stages (P2).
InferenceMetadata.title: InferenceMetadata

InferenceSettings.description: Effective inference parameters used by one detector invocation.
InferenceSettings.title: InferenceSettings

InferenceStageMetadata.description: Per-stage inference traceability for one inspection (contract 03).
InferenceStageMetadata.title: InferenceStageMetadata

InspectionDecision.description: Deterministic inspection decision produced by the rule engine.
InspectionDecision.title: InspectionDecision

InspectionImages.description:
Image slot URLs plus per-slot lifecycle state (F14).

A PURGED slot carries no content URL so the UI renders an explicit purged
state instead of a broken image; UNAVAILABLE covers missing or failed media.
InspectionImages.title: InspectionImages

MediaMetadata.title: MediaMetadata

ProductDetection.title: ProductDetection

ROIResult.description: Generated product ROI and full-frame/ROI coordinate transform.
ROIResult.title: ROIResult

ReasonCount.description: A single reason code with its occurrence count.
ReasonCount.title: ReasonCount

UploadTask.description: Persistent upload work item (design 04 section 7, ADR-005).
UploadTask.title: UploadTask

VideoFrameInspectResult.description: One analyzed frame's decision summary (web dev test harness, ADR-014).
VideoFrameInspectResult.title: VideoFrameInspectResult

VideoInspectResult.description:
Per-frame summary for an uploaded test video (ADR-014).

``truncated`` is true when a decode resource budget (frame count or wall
clock) ended iteration early, so consumers do not mistake the summary for a
complete analysis of the source video (F6).
VideoInspectResult.title: VideoInspectResult

post.description: Exchange a configured bearer token for an HttpOnly same-origin session.

get.description: Camera connection and capture settings; per-instance when requested.
Return the latest captured frame as a rate-limited JPEG (ADR-013).

post.description: Inspect one uploaded image; writes an evidence bundle unless persist=false.

Analyze an uploaded video frame by frame; returns a summary only.

The video is streamed to a temporary file (never held fully in memory),
decoded with the shared :class:`VideoFrameSource`, and at most
``_MAX_VIDEO_FRAMES`` sampled frames are inspected without persisting
evidence (ADR-014). ``step`` is bounded and the total decode work is
bounded by ``_MAX_DECODED_FRAMES`` and ``_MAX_VIDEO_DECODE_SECONDS``;
``truncated`` is set when a decode budget ends iteration early.

get.description: Process liveness only; never blocks on dependencies.
